decisions.rationale: Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to test independent site effects relative to the baseline configuration.

Configuration 4 yields low f2 while dramatically reducing f1 relative to original. Testing variations around s1=C and s5=A or C, combined with s3 variants, to seek better trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Combine low f1 labels (s1=B, s3=C, s5=D) while testing s2=B and s6=A/B variations to explore Pareto improvements between f1 ~ 9k-87k and low f2.
s1=B, s2=A with s3=C or B achieves strong f1 without excessively sacrificing f2. Testing s6=A with s5=C or B, and exploring s1=D combinations to map trade-offs.
Testing s4=B with low f2 choices (s1=C, s1=E, s5=D) and s3=A/B to probe the intermediate region between low-f1 (s4=B) and low-f2 (s5=D, s6=A).
s4=B drastically reduces f1 while maintaining low f2 with s6=A. Exploring s5 choices with s4=B and s3=B/A could uncover better intermediate trade-offs between f1 ~9k and f1 ~39k.
Test s4=B with s1=E and s5=C/D to seek lower f2 while preserving f1 gains, and test s3=D with s4=B.
Investigate s1=E with s4=B to find ultra-low f2, and explore s3=E or s5=D with s6=B effects to push low f1 tradeoffs.
Test s3=E and s3=A with s4=B, s1=E/C, and s5=D to capture non-dominated trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Combining s1=C/E with s3=E or s3=C and s4=B/s5=D targets lower f1 and f2. Testing s1=D variants explores underrepresented s1 values.
Test s5=E with s4=B to achieve ultra-low f1, and explore s1=E, s2=A with s3=C, s4=B to improve low-f2 trade-offs.
Testing s4=B with s1=E, s2=A across low-f2 sites (s3=C is restricted by s4 ignored, but s3=E/B paired with s5=D/A balances f1 and f2 near Pareto front).
Testing s3=C with s4=B and s1 in {C, E, B} to break past f1 trade-offs, and probing s1=D for ultra-low f1 with varied s5 configurations.
Test s6=B with s4=B to find ultra-low f1 points (<10k) with better f2 than config 3, and explore s1=E, s2=B combined with s3=E, s4=B to improve low-f2 boundaries.
Explore the ultra-low f1 and f2 trade-off by combining high-performing settings (s4=B, s6=B) across under-explored combinations of s1, s3, and s5.
Test s1=E, s2=A with s3=C, s5=D and s6=B variations, and evaluate s1=C with s3=E, s5=B, s6=B to discover lower f1/f2 trade-offs.
Explores the ultra-low f1 region with s6=B combined with high-performing Pareto sites (s1=C,A, s3=E, s5=A/E), and tests combinations around s1=E, s3=E, s5=D for low f2.
Combine top low-f1 patterns (s3=E, s4=B, s5=E, s6=B) with s1=D to push the minimum f1 boundary, and explore s1=E, s2=B with s3=E, s4=A for minimum f2.
Test s1=E, s2=A with s3=E, s4=A and explore s1=C with s5=E, s6=B permutations to find minimal f1 and f2 trade-offs.
Exploit the high-f2/low-f1 frontier with s1=A,B,C, s3=E, s4=B, s5=D/E, and target unexplored low-f2 trade-offs with s1=E, s2=B.
Explore alternative categorical labels across primary sites s1, s3, and s5 systematically from the original configuration baseline to identify strong objective trade-offs and sensitivity.

Evaluations show s1=A and s3=A reduce f1 with minimal f2 penalty, while s1=C drastically cuts f1 at high f2 cost. We combine s1=A with s3=A, and explore s1=C and other labels under controlled baselines.
s1=A and s4=B both significantly reduce f1 with minor f2 cost. We combine s1=A and s4=B with varied s3 (C, A, D) and s5 labels to discover further trade-offs.
Combining s1=A and s4=B with s3=C and s5=B, plus exploring s6=B or s5=C/E, aims to achieve even lower f1 while keeping f2 reasonably low compared to config 6.
Combine top-performing s5=C with varied s3 settings (s3=D, B, A) and explore s4=A on s5=C to discover low f1 and low f2 trade-offs.
Combine top-performing labels: test s5=C across diverse s1 options (like s1=D for low f2) and s6=B to explore potential extreme f1 gains alongside s5=C.
Test s1=E and s1=B with s3=D/s5=C to improve low f2; explore combinations with s6=B for extremely low f1; test s5=A interactions.
Testing s5=C combined with s6=B or varying s1/s3 to push f1 even lower, while evaluating s1=D with s3=A/C and s5=C to optimize f2.
Evaluating s6=B combined with s5=C or s3=D to test extreme low f1 configurations, and probing s2=A with s1=D to explore low f2 compromises.
Test s2=A on s1=E/C variants, and examine s1=D s2=A with s3=C s5=B, plus s6=B with s1=D to explore low f1/f2 trade-offs.
Test combination of low-f1 features (s1=A/C/D, s2=A/B, s3=C/D, s5=B/C) with s6=B to discover lower f1 values, and explore s2=A with s3=D on s5=C.
Test s1=D, s2=A with s3=D and s5=C/D variations to optimize the low-f2 region, and explore s1=E, s2=A combinations that may outperform current Pareto points.
Combining s1=D, s2=A with s3=C, s4=B and other s5 values, or testing s1=A with s3=D and s5=A/E, to bridge Pareto trade-offs.
Evaluating s1=B with s3=C, s4=B, s5=B, s6=B to test whether s1=B can push the low-f1 boundary further than 9042.
Test s1=D with s2=A, s3=C/A, s4=B, s5=D/C to push the low f2 region, and explore s1=C/A variants with s5=C and s6=B to seek Pareto improvements.
Test s1=D, s2=A with s3=C, s4=B to find lower f2 than s1=A, or s5=C combined with low f1 labels to discover non-dominated trade-offs near f2=2496-3000.
Testing s5=B, s6=B with s3=E or s5=E, and evaluating s1=D, s2=B vs s2=A combinations to uncover lower f1 or f2 values along the Pareto front.
Testing s5=C combined with s6=B or unexplored s1/s3 combinations to lower f1 beyond 9000 or explore trade-offs between f2=2800-3200.
Testing s1=D, s2=A with s3=C, s4=B to find lower f1 under low f2, and exploring s1=C with s5=C/s3=C variations.
Test s2=A across remaining s1 levels (C, B) with s3=D, s5=C, and probe s6=B configurations under s1=C/B with s3=C, s5=D/C for potential low f1 breakthroughs.
Evaluate s1=A with s3=D and s5=C combined with s6=B or s1=D/s2=B trade-offs to probe boundaries between lowest f1 and lowest f2.
Evaluating s1=B with s3=C, s4=B, s5=D, s6=B tests if label B on s1 can achieve an ultra-low f1 along the extreme lower edge, complementing existing Pareto optimal configs.
Exploration begins by varying the primary categorical variables s1, s3, and s5 systematically away from default levels to probe objective sensitivity and trade-offs.
Config 6 yielded a substantial drop in f1 with reasonable f2. We explore variations around s1=E, testing alternative values for s3 and s5 to further optimize f2 and f1.
s1=E yields lowest f1; s3=C and s4=A minimize f1 while s4=B reduces f2. Testing s3=B with s1=E, and exploring unmeasured s5 levels (e.g. E) to lower f2 below 2880.
s1=E and s5=D achieve low f1. s3=B provided the lowest f2 among s1=E configurations. Testing s1=E with s3=B and alternative s5 values or exploring s1=C and s1=D with s3=B to minimize f2.
s1=E, s5=D, s4=A yields low f1, while s3=B, s1=D yields optimal f2. Testing s1=E with s3=C, s4=A and alternative s5/s6 settings or s1=D/C with s3=C/A to improve the Pareto trade-off.
Test s1=D with s3=C, s4=B to reach low f2 while varying s2=A; explore s1=C with s3=B, s2=A for balanced trade-offs; evaluate s1=B variants.

Testing s1=A with promising s3/s4 combinations (C-A and B) and s5=D, which consistently yields low f1 across other s1 settings, along with exploring s1=D with s3=A, s4=A on s5=D to push the trade-off.
Evaluating s3=E combinations with top low-f1 branches and testing s5 labels with low-f2 baselines to explore extreme trade-offs along the Pareto front.
s1=E with s5=D gives the lowest f1/f2 balanced profile. Evaluating unexplored s3 values and s2 variations with other promising labels tests potential Pareto improvements.
Testing s5 variants with s1=E, s3=C, s4=A which consistently yielded near-optimal f1, and checking whether s5=D is strictly required or if s6 interactions help lower f2.
Testing s6=B with top low-f1 configurations (s1=B/C/A, s3=C, s5=C) to discover even lower f1 values, along with exploring s1=D, s3=D, s4=A for low f2.
Test combination of s6=B for minimum f1 with s3=B/E, and test s1=D with s3=B, s4=B with other s5 values to find lowest f2.
Evaluating s1=D, s2=A, s3=C, s4=A with s5=C, s6=B to explore the extreme low f1 region with potentially better f2.
Testing s5=E, s5=A, and s5=B with s6=B to explore potential lowest f1 values beyond s5=C, while maintaining top-performing s1/s2/s3 combinations.
Test s5=B with s6=B alongside top s1-s3 combos to explore lower f1, and test s1=C with s5=E, s6=B for Pareto improvements.
Testing s3=E combined with s5=E, s6=B to push f1 lower, exploring s5=A/s6=A trade-offs, and probing s3=B/s4=A interactions under D/E.
Test s1=E, s3=C, s4=A with s5=A and s6=B to seek lower f1/f2, explore s1=D with low-cost components, and probe s6=B on other promising settings.
Combine best features: s3=C, s4=A, s6=B yields lowest f1 (~9k), while s1=E/B/C and s5=E/A/B optimize. Also explore s5=B/E with s6=A to break into Pareto-efficient mid f1/low f2 trade-offs.
Combine top-performing low-f1 settings (s3=C, s4=A, s5=E, s6=B) and low-f2 settings (s3=B, s4=B) to find non-dominated trade-offs.
Test s1=E with s3=B and s5=A/C/B to push the trade-off near minimum f2 (2816/2496) and lower f1; also test s3=C, s4=B on s5=E/s6=B.
Initial exploration across key categorical factors (s1, s3, s5) to probe main effects relative to the baseline configuration.
Combine top f1 performer s1=B with top f2 choices (s5=A or D), while testing unexplored binary modifiers like s4=B and s6=A to lower both objectives.
Combining effective reductions: s1=B strongly reduces f1, s4=B reduces f1 further, and s5=A also reduces f1 without massive f2 blowups. Testing combinations of s1=B, s4=B, and s5=A.
s1=B and s4=B strongly reduce f1 while s5=A retains low f2. Combining s1=B, s4=B, s5=A with other untested sites (s3 variants or s5=C/E) can discover new Pareto-optimal trade-offs.
s1=B, s3=D, s4=B, s5=A yielded lowest f1 (64048). Testing s5=E (bypassing s6) or testing s3=D with other s5 values can further advance the Pareto frontier.
s5=E achieved our lowest f1 (39301) with competitive f2. Testing s5=E combined with varied s3 and s4 labels, plus testing s1=D/s2=A combinations, to map the low-f1 boundary.
Testing s3=E against s2=A with s5=E to improve f2, and checking whether s1=A/E combine favorably with the high-performing s3=D/E, s4=B, s5=E backbone.
Combine top-performing sites (s5=E, s6=B, s4=B) with s1=D/B and explore s3/s2 combinations to find non-dominated points balancing low f1 and f2.
Test s1=A with s3=E to potentially discover low f2 variants, and explore s1=E/C with s2=A or s5=E configurations.
Test s1=E, s2=A with s3=E to explore the f2 vs f1 frontier, and test s1=C with s5=E combinations which are currently unexplored.
Explore combinations around the Pareto frontier: testing s3=B with s2=B/A and s5=E, plus inspecting s3=E variants where f2 is minimized (e.g. s4 is ignored).
Focusing on s5=E with combinations of s3=D and s3=E. Evaluating s1=B with s3=E and s4=B to test if s4 interacts with s3=E, or testing untested labels/combinations.
Testing s4=B with s3=E to potentially improve f1 while keeping f2 competitive, and testing s1=C s2=A combinations or s3=C/D with low f2 features to fill gaps along the Pareto frontier.
Testing s5=E with s6=A to combine the strong f1 reductions of s5=E and s6=A, and exploring s1=D/B with s3=E/s4=B variations to advance the f2/f1 Pareto frontier.
Testing s5=E with s6=A across low-f1 candidates (s1=B,C,D,E) to discover extreme low f1 values, and probing s1=C s2=A s3=D s4=B s5=A s6=A for an optimal minimum f1.
Testing s5=E (which ignores s6) across top-performing s1/s2/s3 combinations with s4=B to find lower f1 and trade-offs near the Pareto frontier.
Combining s1=D, s2=B with s3=E or s4=B at s5=E optimizes f2 down to 2496. We explore s1=D with s2=B variants to push f1 lower while preserving minimum f2.
Testing s5=E combined with s3=E to seek improvements along the low-f2 boundary, and testing unexplored combinations around the low f1 Pareto boundary with s6=A.
Combine minimal f1 drivers (s1=B/E/C, s3=D, s4=B, s6=A) with low f2 choices to discover new extremes and fill Pareto gaps.
Testing s5=E configurations with s6=A or low-f2 variants (s1=B, s3=D) to explore whether s5=E can achieve ultra-low f1 while improving f2 trade-offs.
Evaluating s6=A with low-f1 combinations (s3=D, s4=B) across s5 variants or testing s1=B, s3=E, s4=A, s5=E with other s6 to improve the low-f2 boundary.
Evaluate the extreme low-f1 region: with s5=E, s6 is ignored, but test if s1=B, s3=D, s4=B with s5=E yields the top f1 trade-off, or explore s1=C with s6=A.
Initial exploration across diverse site assignments to detect individual parameter sensitivities and establish broad baselines across both objectives.
Config 2 has exceptionally low f1 while config 3 offers balanced trade-offs. We test combinations of s1=A/B with s6=B to drive down f2 while maintaining low f1.
Test combinations of s1=A, s2=A with s3=C and s5=A/B to balance ultra-low f1 from config 2 with low f2 from configs 3 and 8.
Test s5=D with low-f1 features (s1=A/B, s2=A, s4=A) to reach the low f2 region (~2496) while keeping f1 moderate, and test s3=A/C combinations with s6=A/B.
Testing s3=D and s3=E with low-cost components (s1=A/B, s2=A, s4=A, s5=B, s6=B) and s6=B with s5=C to discover lower f2 or balanced trade-offs.
s3=E reduces f2 significantly (eval 23). Testing s3=E with s5=A and s6=A/B aims to push lower f2 while preserving low f1. Also exploring s3=D/B with varied s5/s6 settings.
Test s3=E with s5=D/s6=B and s1=D combinations to drive f2 lower toward original levels, and test s3=B/D with s4=B to explore potential f2 reductions.
Exploring s1=D combinations with s3=D/C and s5=B, aiming for lower f2 near 2800 while maintaining moderate f1, plus testing s3=D at lowest f1 with s6=A.
s1=D provides low f2, while s5=B and s3=B/E offer favorable tradeoffs. Testing s1=D with s3=B and unexplored variants near the low f2 boundary.
Explore s1=D with s2=B across s3 variants (A, C) to optimize low f2 regions, and test s1=C configurations with low f1 potential given s6=B.
s1=C exhibits excellent performance for both f1 and f2. Testing s3=A and s3=C with s1=C, and exploring s1=C with s5=B,s6=B combinations to find new trade-offs.
s1=C offers low f1 and competitive f2. Testing s1=C with s3=E or s3=D on s5=D/C explores better trade-offs near the low f2 region where D was strong.
Testing s1=C with s3=E/D and unexplored site combinations (s5=A, s6=B or s4 variations) to improve Pareto trade-offs near f2=2816 and f1=9042.
Testing s1=D and s1=C with s5=B, s6=B, exploring under-evaluated s3 and s4 options (especially s4=B with s3=D) and checking s1=E/B interactions for low f2.
Testing s1=D, s2=B with s3=A, s4=B to find lower f2 alongside low f1, and evaluating s1=B with s3=D and other s5 values.
Focus on high-performing low f1 (s1=B/C, s5=A, s6=A) and explore under-tested s5 options with s1=D/C for low f2.
Evaluating s1=D with s3=E/D and s5=B/A combinations to find non-dominated trade-offs near the f2 minimum, and testing s1=C with s3=D/E variants.
Testing s1=D with s3=D and s3=A combined with s2=B, s4=B, s5=B, s6=A/B or unexplored variants to find lower f1 while preserving the minimal f2=2496 observed in evaluations 43 and 72.
Target the frontier between low f1 and low f2 by pairing s1=C with optimal settings s4=A, s5=B, and varying s3, plus exploring s1=D with s2=B, s4=B.
Test s1=D, s2=B combined with s3=D/C and s5=B, s6=B with s4=A or s5=D to push f2 towards the global minimum while keeping f1 moderate.
